name: Hyprop Investments Limited
source: CRON 20261014: Hyprop Investments Limited summarised consolidated audited results for the year ended 30 June 2026 (annual results booklet page 18, hyprop.co.za), rand thousands. Printed: revenue 5111663 (lease revenue 3867662, non-lease revenue 1244001), property expenses 2162840, net property income 2942780, other operating expenses 192416, operating income 2753538, net interest 892191 (interest income 62691, interest expense 954882), net income before value adjustments 1861347, changes in fair value 1991454, profit before taxation 3866952, taxation 228589, profit for the year 3638363 of which 3640867 attributable to shareholders of the company (non-controlling interests minus 2504), basic earnings per share 902.9 cents. Cost of Sales is the property expenses line, the basis already stored for FY2025. Operating Expenses is the printed other operating expenses 192416 plus the net foreign exchange loss 101 plus 2768, being the change in expected credit losses on trade receivables 6043 less other operating income 3275, so that gross profit less operating expenses equals the printed operating income 2753538 exactly. Operating Profit (EBIT) is the printed operating income line. Net income before value adjustments is reproduced exactly as operating income less net interest. Profit before taxation less taxation equals the printed profit for the year 3638363. | source_url: https://www.hyprop.co.za/results/annuals-2026/pdf/booklet.pdf RECONCILE 20261014: an earlier pass had written Operating Expenses 195285000, Net Finance Costs 954882000 (gross interest expense) and Net Profit 3638363000 (profit for the year before non-controlling interests) into the partner key of this file. The values now stored in both keys are the above; Net Finance Costs is the printed net interest of 892191 because that is the figure Hyprop itself labels net interest and it ties operating income to the printed net income before value adjustments, and Net Profit is the attributable figure so that it ties to the printed basic earnings per share of 902.9 cents.
